name: prompt-rejector
description: Security gateway for LLM agents: detects prompt injections, jailbreaks, lethal-trifecta agent configurations, Hugging Face model risks, MCP tool poisoning, and classic web vulnerabilities. Ships an MCP server (11 tools) and a REST API.
